conditions: Signed-in customer on a product detail page
Customer clicks the Add to Favourites button
items.expected: The favourites button changes state (e.g. filled/active icon or label change) confirming the add action; the product then appears in the customer's favourites list when the favourites page is opened

conditions: Signed-in customer with at least one product already in their favourites list
Customer clicks the Remove button for that product
items.expected: The product's remove control confirms the action (button/icon disappears or changes state); the product is no longer shown in the favourites list

conditions: User navigates directly to the favourites page URL
items.expected: User is redirected to the sign-in page; the favourites list content is not shown

conditions: Signed-in customer on the favourites page
items.expected: No WCAG A/AA violations reported by axe-core for the favourites page

excluded.reason: AC-3 covers the unauthenticated access guard as a functional test; no additional security surface (account enumeration, token exposure) is implied by the favourites feature beyond what TOOL-13 already covers
TOOL-21 (admin product search) and TOOL-20 (billing address) are both Active bugs that do not touch the favourites feature; no Resolved bugs exist in this story's scope
Active bug about admin product search narrowing — unrelated to customer favourites; not tested here
Active bug about billing address pre-fill — unrelated to customer favourites; not tested here
